content.content: {"result":"{\"success\": true, \"data\": {\"path\": \"/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513_6/projects/faith-evidence-ie/literature_map.yaml\", \"content\": \"# Literature Map for faith-evidence-ie (FREIGE)\\n# Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE\\n# Updated: 2026-05-15\\n\\npapers:\\n\\n  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization\\\"\\n    authors: NVIDIA Labs\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: ICML 2026\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: closest_prior_work\\n    key_finding: >\\n      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，\\n      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，\\n      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），\\n      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。\\n      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs\\\"\\n    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2505.09655\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。\\n      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，\\n      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。\\n      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards\\\"\\n    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2511.03710\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。\\n      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，\\n      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。\\n      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2502.18770\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，\\n      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，\\n      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合\\\"先快后慢\\\"的 reward shaping 原则。\\n\\n  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale\\\"\\n    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: NeurIPS 2025\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: key_baseline\\n    key_finding: >\\n      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。\\n      DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（放大 importance sampling 上界）和 Dynamic Sampling\\n      来对抗 entropy collapse，在 AIME 2024 上超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse；CED reward 本身就能防止 mode collapse，\\n      无需额外 clip 调整。reward design vs. algorithm trick 的对比。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO\\\"\\n    authors: Liu et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: COLM 2025\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: related_analysis\\n    key_finding: >\\n      GRPO 的 std 归一化对低 variance 组（全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重引入 difficulty bias。\\n      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化项消除偏差，在 per-token 基础上表现更优。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      分析了 reward_std→0 时的问题（advantage 异常放大或归零），\\n      与我们观察到的 extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象高度一致。\\n      CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，避免了这一 bias。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: NeurIPS 2025\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: alternative_framework\\n    key_finding: >\\n      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，\\n      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，\\n      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization\\\"\\n    authors: Jian Hu et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2501.03262\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。\\n      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。\\n      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO\\\"\\n    authors: Henglin Liu et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2512.21514\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: parallel_work\\n    key_finding: >\\n      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）\\n      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——\\n      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2601.23135\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，\\n      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，\\n      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。\\n\\n  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards\\\"\\n    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: arXiv 2403.07708\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708\\n    category: contrastive_reward\\n    role: closest_contrastive_precedent\\n    key_finding: >\\n      Contrastive reward 让 LLM 惩罚 reward uncertainty、改善鲁棒性、\\n      根据任务难度自适应校准、减少 PPO 中的 variance。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      最接近的对比 reward 先例。但针对 RLHF 通用场景，\\n      CED 是 task-specific evidence discrimination 对比信号，且在 GRPO（非 PPO）中验证。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: EMNLP 2024\\n    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/\\n    category: contrastive_reward\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，\\n      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，\\n      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: ICLR 2025\\n    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj\\n    category: contrastive_reward\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。\\n\\n  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: ACL 2025\\n    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf\\n    category: evidence_reward\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination\\n      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: EACL 2024\\n    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/\\n    category: evidence_reward\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024\\n    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/\\n    category: evidence_reward\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，\\n      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。\\n\\n  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: OpenReview\\n    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU\\n    category: multi_objective_rl\\n    role: related_analysis\\n    key_finding: >\\n      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，\\n      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），\\n      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，\\n      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2505.23585\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585\\n    category: multi_objective_rl\\n    role: theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，\\n      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——\\n      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。\\n\\n  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce\\\"\\n    authors: Xiao et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2504.11343\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343\\n    category: rsft_methodology\\n    role: key_theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。\\n      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。\\n      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      直接支持我们的设计选择：RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败的原因可能是\\n      structured output（DocRE）比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，\\n      而 rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)\\\"\\n    authors: Jie Deng et al.\\n    year: 2026\\n    venue: arXiv 2602.04391\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391\\n    category: rsft_methodology\\n    role: method_component\\n    key_finding: >\\n      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，\\n      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。\\n      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，\\n      融合方式需要重新设计。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: ICML 2025\\n    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir\\n    category: rsft_methodology\\n    role: theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning\\n      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为\\n      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，\\n      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。\\n\\n  # === Category 7: RL for Information Extraction ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR\\\"\\n    authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2507.04642\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04642\\n    category: rl_for_ie\\n    role: direct_competitor\\n    key_finding: >\\n      首个将 RLVR（GRPO + verifiable reward）用于关系抽取的框架。\\n      将 RE 重构为推理任务，R1-RE-7B 在跨域 OOD 准确率约 70%，\\n      媲美 GPT-4o。在 SemEval-2010 Task 8 和私有 MDKG 数据集上评估。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      最直接竞争者。但关键差异：(1) R1-RE 是句子级 RE，我们是文档级 RE；\\n      (2) R1-RE 用 online GRPO，我们用 offline RSFT；\\n      (3) R1-RE 无 evidence extraction 组件，我们有 CED reward；\\n      (4) R1-RE 关注 OOD 泛化，我们关注 evidence-grounded extraction quality。\\n      互补而非直接冲突。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"MORE-R1: Guiding LVLM for Multimodal Object-Entity Relation Extraction via Stepwise Reasoning with RL\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2026\\n    venue: arXiv 2603.09478\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09478\\n    category: rl_for_ie\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      多模态 RE 中用 GRPO + Progressive Sample-Mixing Strategy 优化 LVLM 推理能力。\\n      两阶段训练：SFT cold-start + GRPO RL。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      跨模态验证 RL for RE 趋势。其 Progressive Sample-Mixing 与我们\\n      RSFT 的 difficulty-aware sampling 思想相通，但在不同模态。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"REAR: Reinforced Reasoning Optimization for Event Argument Extraction with Relation-Aware Support\\\"\\n    authors: Jianwen Luo et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: EMNLP 2025 Findings\\n    url: https://2025.emnlp.org/program/find_papers/\\n    category: rl_for_ie\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      将强化学习推理优化用于事件论元抽取，结合关系感知支持。\\n      不同于 DocRE 但同属 IE 领域的 RL 应用。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      验证 RL 在 IE 任务上的有效性趋势。我们的工作扩展到 DocRE + evidence，\\n      且使用 offline RSFT 而非 online RL。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Adaptive Reinforcement Learning Planning: Harnessing LLMs for Complex Information Extraction\\\"\\n    authors: Zepeng Ding et al.\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: arXiv 2406.11455\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.11455\\n    category: rl_for_ie\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      将 LLM 顺序抽取建模为 MDP，用 DDQN 训练 decision module\\n      自适应选择实体抽取顺序，提升复杂 IE 性能。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      RL for IE 的早期工作。用 RL 优化抽取策略而非模型本身，\\n      与我们 RSFT 直接微调 LLM 的方法路径不同。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Graph-R1: Towards Agentic GraphRAG Framework via End-to-end Reinforcement Learning\\\"\\n    authors: Haoran Luo et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: ICML 2026\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.21892\\n    category: rl_for_ie\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      用端到端 RL 优化 GraphRAG agent 的多轮检索-推理循环，\\n      包含 knowledge hypergraph construction（n-ary relation extraction）。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      RL + knowledge extraction 的交叉点。Graph-R1 关注 QA 场景下的知识图谱构建，\\n      我们关注 DocRE 的训练优化，应用场景不同。\\n\\n  # === Category 8: Recent LLM-based DocRE Methods ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"RelPrior: Relation as a Prior - A Novel Paradigm for LLM-based Document-level Relation Extraction\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2511.08143\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08143\\n    category: llm_docre\\n    role: key_baseline\\n    key_finding: >\\n      用 binary relation 作为先验过滤无关实体对，再用 predefined relation 匹配实体，\\n      避免 LLM 在 DocRE 中被无关实体对分散注意力。\\n      在 DocRED/Re-DocRED 上超越现有 LLM-based DocRE 方法。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      我们的直接 baseline 之一。RelPrior 在 DocRED 上提升 +2.06-2.38pp，\\n      我们的 RSFT 提升 +5.98pp 显著更优。\\n      RelPrior 是 inference paradigm 创新，我们是 training paradigm 创新，正交互补。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"LMRC: LLM with Relation Classifier for Document-Level Relation Extraction\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: arXiv 2408.13889\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.13889\\n    category: llm_docre\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      两阶段方法：先用 attention-based classifier 过滤 NA 实体对（RCP），\\n      再用 LLM 在精简候选空间中做多分类（RC）。\\n      在 DocRED/Re-DocRED 上显著优于其他 LLM-based DocRE 方法。\\n    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >\\n      LMRC 用小模型预筛选 + LLM 分类的 pipeline 方式，与我们端到端 LLM 生成方式不同。\\n      展示 LLM-based DocRE 的 class imbalance 挑战，我们通过 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 隐式解决。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization\\\"\\n    authors: NVIDIA Labs\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: ICML 2026\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: closest_prior_work\\n    key_finding: >\\n      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，\\n      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，\\n      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），\\n      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。\\n      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs\\\"\\n    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2505.09655\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。\\n      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，\\n      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。\\n      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards\\\"\\n    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2511.03710\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。\\n      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，\\n      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。\\n      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2502.18770\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，\\n      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，\\n      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合\\\"先快后慢\\\"的 reward shaping 原则。\\n\\n  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO\\\"\\n    authors: Liu et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: COLM 2025\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: related_analysis\\n    key_finding: >\\n      GRPO 的 std 归一化对低 variance 组（全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重引入 difficulty bias。\\n      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化项消除偏差，在 per-token 基础上表现更优。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      分析了 reward_std→0 时的问题（advantage 异常放大或归零），\\n      与我们观察到的 extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象高度一致。\\n      CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，避免了这一 bias。\\n\\n  - # Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE
# Updated: 2026-05-15

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（放大 importance sampling 上界）和 Dynamic Sampling
      来对抗 entropy collapse，在 AIME 2024 上超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse；CED reward 本身就能防止 mode collapse，
      无需额外 clip 调整。reward design vs. algorithm trick 的对比。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化对低 variance 组（全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重引入 difficulty bias。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化项消除偏差，在 per-token 基础上表现更优。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      分析了 reward_std→0 时的问题（advantage 异常放大或归零），
      与我们观察到的 extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象高度一致。
      CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，避免了这一 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，
      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，
      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===

  - title: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"
    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.07708
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: closest_contrastive_precedent
    key_finding: >
      Contrastive reward 让 LLM 惩罚 reward uncertainty、改善鲁棒性、
      根据任务难度自适应校准、减少 PPO 中的 variance。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最接近的对比 reward 先例。但针对 RLHF 通用场景，
      CED 是 task-specific evidence discrimination 对比信号，且在 GRPO（非 PPO）中验证。

  - title: "Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EMNLP 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，
      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，
      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。

  - title: "Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。

  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===

  - title: "Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ACL 2025
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf
    category: evidence_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination
      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。

  - title: "Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EACL 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。

  - title: "Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024
    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，
      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。

  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===

  - title: "Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: OpenReview
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，
      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），
      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，
      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。

  - title: "On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.23585
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，
      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——
      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败的原因可能是
      structured output（DocRE）比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      而 rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2602.04391
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，
      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。
      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，
      融合方式需要重新设计。

  - title: "Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning
      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为
      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，
      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。

  # === Category 7: RL for Information Extraction ===

  - title: "R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR"
    authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2507.04642
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04642
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: direct_competitor

Based on the search results, I found detailed information about the arXiv paper 2503.20783. Here's what the research is about:

## Overview

The paper "Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective" examines R1-Zero-like training by analyzing its two core components: base models and RL.

## Key Findings on Dr. GRPO and Normalization Bias

The research identifies an optimization bias in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which artificially increases response length (especially for incorrect outputs) during training.

Dr. GRPO introduces simple yet significant modifications to address the biases in GRPO by removing the length and std normalization terms.

### The Bias Issues Fixed by Dr. GRPO

According to the research, there are two key optimization biases in GRPO that Dr. GRPO addresses:

1. **Response Length Bias**: GRPO's normalization by sequence length causes longer incorrect responses to be under-penalized.

2. **Question-Level Difficulty Bias**: Normalizing advantages by std(r) gives disproportionate weight to questions with low standard deviations (typically very easy or very hard questions).

## Solution

Dr. GRPO is an unbiased optimization method that improves token efficiency while maintaining reasoning performance. Dr. GRPO can effectively mitigate the optimization bias and lead to better token efficiency.

## R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR

R1-RE is the first reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) framework for relation extraction (RE) tasks. The approach reframes RE as a reasoning task guided by annotation guidelines.

### Key Technical Details

The paper formulates the language generation process of LLMs as a sequential decision process and optimizes the LLM with the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm. 

Regarding the reward design, the reward consists of two components: a format reward that checks whether the model's response adheres to a specified structure, and an accuracy reward where for relation classification, a binary reward is employed—assigning positive feedback for correct predictions and negative feedback for incorrect ones.

### Performance and Results

The method elicits the reasoning abilities of small language models for annotation tasks, resulting in significantly improved out-of-domain (OOD) robustness. The R1-RE-7B model attains an average OOD accuracy of approximately 70%, on par with leading proprietary models such as GPT-4o.

The paper references work on catastrophic forgetting (Kotha et al., 2023) but the search results don't show extensive discussion of catastrophic forgetting specifically at the sentence-level in this paper.

Based on the search results, I found the paper you're looking for. The paper proposes a novel "Relation as a Prior" (RelPrior) paradigm for LLM-based document-level relation extraction (DocRE).

The research addresses performance gaps in document-level relation extraction, where the commonly adopted "extract entities then predict relations" paradigm leads to challenges due to numerous unrelated entity pairs introducing noise. RelPrior utilizes binary relation as a prior to extract and determine whether two entities are correlated, thereby filtering out irrelevant entity pairs and reducing prediction noise.

Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate that RelPrior achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing LLM-based methods. The paper provides detailed F1 score analysis, with specific performance metrics for different relation types, noting that four relationships with the best performance were P569 ("date of birth"), P570 ("date of death"), P19 ("place of birth"), and P102 ("member of political party"), while four worst-performing relationships were P31 ("instance of"), P190 ("sister city"), P551 ("residence"), and P676 ("lyrics by").

## DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale

The paper proposes the Decoupled Clip and Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO) algorithm, introducing 4 key techniques to make RL shine in the long-CoT RL scenario.

### Key Issues Addressed

The paper observed the entropy collapse phenomenon in naive PPO and GRPO experiments, where the entropy of the policy decreases quickly as training progresses. A thorough analysis reveals that the naive GRPO baseline suffers from several key issues such as entropy collapse, reward noise, and training instability.

### Main Findings on Normalization Bias

The original GRPO algorithm employs a sample-level loss calculation, which involves first averaging the losses by token within each sample and then aggregating the losses across samples. In this approach, each sample is assigned an equal weight in the final loss computation. However, the paper finds that this method of loss reduction introduces several challenges in the context of long-CoT RL scenarios.

### Results

DAPO achieves 50 points on AIME 2024 based on Qwen2.5-32B model, outperforming previous state-of-the-art results achieved by DeepSeek-R1-Zero-Qwen-32B (47 points) using 50% training steps.

The paper addresses critical training details for reproducible large-scale LLM RL systems and has been released as open-source code.

## Fully Supervised Results on Re-DocRED

GLiDRE achieves a test F1 score of 77.83 on the Re-DocRED benchmark. This places GLiDRE in close competition with established DocRE models like ATLOP and KD-DocRE.

While it does not surpass the current state-of-the-art methods like DREEAM and TTM-RE, these models incorporate additional mechanisms such as evidence information for DREEAM and the Turing Token Machine for TTM-RE that is designed to scale better than GLiDRE's approach with large datasets.

## Zero-Shot Results

GLiDRE, a model with only a few hundred million parameters, achieves a zero-shot test F1 score of 17.32, outperforming Llama 3.3 70B and Mistral-Small 24B.

## Few-Shot Results

Experiments in both low-resource supervised training and few-shot meta-learning benchmarks show that GLiDRE's approach outperforms existing methods in data-constrained scenarios, establishing a new state-of-the-art in few-shot document-level relation extraction.

## Ru-LLM: Logical Rule-Constrained LLMs for Document-Level Relation Extraction

Ru-LLM (Rule-constrained LLMs) is a novel framework that learns logical rules to enhance the performance of LLMs in Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE). This paper was published at NLPCC 2025 (Natural Language Processing and Chinese Computing).

### Key Technical Approach

Ru-LLM leverages frequent pattern mining and LLM-assisted completion to obtain candidate predicate pool, and incorporates the Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm to efficiently search for and generate logical rules through a four-stage process: selection, expansion, simulation, and backpropagation.

Ru-LLM transforms logical rules into concise prompts to guide initial result generation, which is then subjected to a Chain-of-Thought verification process that retains only those triples satisfying all rules.

### Experimental Results

Experimental results on the three datasets DWIE, DocRED, and Re-DocRED demonstrate that Ru-LLM outperforms existing implicit reasoning models, LLM-based models, and rule-based frameworks.

### Motivation

Directly applying LLMs to DocRE often results in suboptimal performance, primarily due to long-context inputs inhibiting its reasoning capability, while logical rules can inject refined information into LLMs due to their explicit reasoning process.

I found the paper you're looking for! Here's what the search results reveal about arXiv 2504.11343:

## Paper Overview

Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a prevailing approach for fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks. Among recent methods, GRPO stands out for its empirical success in training models such as DeepSeek-R1, yet the sources of its effectiveness remain poorly understood.

## Key Findings

The work revisits GRPO from a reinforce-like algorithm perspective and analyzes its core components. Surprisingly, a simple rejection sampling baseline, RAFT, which trains only on positively rewarded samples, yields competitive performance than GRPO and PPO.

GRPO's main advantage arises from discarding prompts with entirely incorrect responses, rather than from its reward normalization.

## Proposed Method

Motivated by this insight, the authors propose Reinforce-Rej, a minimal extension of policy gradient that filters both entirely incorrect and entirely correct samples.

## Comparison of Approaches

A key difference between GRPO (Reinforce) and RAFT lies in how they handle negative samples: GRPO mixes both accepted and rejected examples during training, whereas RAFT relies only on positive samples.

## LMRC Paper Overview

The paper introduces Large Language Models with Relation Classifier (LMRC) for document-level relation extraction (DocRE), authored by Xingzuo Li, Kehai Chen, Yunfei Long, and Min Zhang.

## Key Results

The extraction performances of GPT models are quite low before implementing LMRC, while their overall F1 scores are significantly improved after integrating LMRC strategy. Experimental results on the DocRED and Re-DocRED benchmarks show that the proposed LMRC methodology gains significant improvement over other LLM-based DocRE methods.

## Methodology

LMRC conceptualizes DocRE as a workflow comprising two stages: Relation Candidate Proposal (RCP) and Relation Classification (RC). In the RCP stage, a pre-processing classifier is applied which explicitly harnesses attention mechanism to filter out NA entity pairs that do not harbour any relation. Subsequently, the RC stage leverages the remarkable capabilities of LLMs to perform multi-classification within this refined candidate space.

The paper demonstrates that the method significantly outperforms recent LLM-based DocRE models and narrows the performance gap with state-of-the-art BERT-based models.

## Paper Summary: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"

The paper addresses how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), the mainstream paradigm for aligning large language models with human preferences, heavily relies on accurate and informative reward models, which are vulnerable and sensitive to noise from various sources such as human labeling errors, making the pipeline fragile.

### The Contrastive Reward Method

The authors improve the effectiveness of the reward model by introducing a penalty term on the reward named contrastive rewards. The approach involves two steps: (1) an offline sampling step to obtain responses to prompts that serve as baseline calculation and (2) a contrastive reward calculated using the baseline responses and used in the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) step.

### Key Benefits

The contrastive rewards enable the LLM to penalize reward uncertainty, improve robustness, encourage improvement over baselines, calibrate according to task difficulty, and reduce variance in PPO.

### Reward Shaping Approach

Using the sampled baseline responses, the method computes the contrastive rewards by comparing the rewards obtained during RL training to their corresponding contrastive rewards, establishing an implicit comparative reward framework in the RL stage. This "penalty" reward information enables the RL policy to make self-improvements based on the observed differences.

The empirical results show that contrastive rewards can improve RLHF substantially, evaluated by both GPTs and humans, with the method consistently outperforming strong baselines.

# R1-RE Analysis: Key Technical Details

## (1) Does R1-RE use GRPO?

Yes. The paper explicitly states: "we optimize π with respect to this objective using the GRPO algorithm" and provides detailed mathematical formulations of Group Relative Policy Optimization in Section 2.2.

## (2) Catastrophic Forgetting/Training Instability Discussion

The paper addresses this indirectly through Table 4, demonstrating that R1-RE actually **improves** performance on unrelated tasks (MATH-500, IFEval, GPQA) compared to the baseline. The authors note that "RL-based methods can facilitate better skill transfer and generalization across diverse tasks," contrasting favorably with supervised fine-tuning approaches that showed performance degradation.

## (3) Why Sentence-Level RE Succeeds with GRPO

The paper doesn't explicitly discuss why sentence-level tasks succeed while document-level might fail. However, it suggests that verifiable rewards work well because relation classification has clear, rule-based correctness criteria—making it suitable for RLVR frameworks designed around deterministic reward functions.

## (4) Exact Accuracy Numbers

**On SemEval-2010 Task 8** (Sem-2010):
- R1-RE-7B trained on Sem-2010: 91.8% (Avg@4)
- R1-RE-7B trained on MDKG (OOD test): 66.5%

**On MDKG dataset**:
- R1-RE-7B trained on MDKG: 88.1%
- R1-RE-7B trained on Sem-2010 (OOD test): 65.8%

## (5) Reward Design Details

Multi-stage approach combining:

- **Format Reward**: +1 for correct structure, -3 for incorrect format
- **Metric Reward**: +2 for correct classification, -1.5 for incorrect
- **Final Reward**: Format checked first; if valid, metric reward added

For triplet extraction, they use F1-score-based rewards with entity-level (weight=1) and triplet-level (weight=3) components.

content.content:
# DAPO Entropy Collapse Analysis

## (1) Speed of Entropy Decrease
The paper shows entropy declining rapidly during initial GRPO training. Figure 2(b) demonstrates that "the entropy of the policy decreases quickly as training progresses," with sampled responses becoming nearly identical, indicating limited exploration early in training.

## (2) Root Cause
The mechanism stems from clipping constraints. When ε=0.2, a token with probability 0.01 can only increase to 0.012, while a token at 0.9 can reach 1.08. This asymmetry means "for low-probability tokens, achieving a non-trivial increase in probability is considerably more challenging," naturally favoring already-probable actions over exploration of rare tokens.

## (3) Clip-Higher Mechanism Details
DAPO decouples clipping bounds into εlow and εhigh rather than symmetric ε. By increasing εhigh (set to 0.28 vs. standard 0.2), the mechanism "leave[s] more room for the increase of low-probability tokens." This allows underexplored tokens to gain probability more easily while keeping εlow small to prevent sampling collapse.

## (4) Dynamic Sampling Technique
When all outputs for a prompt are correct, they receive identical rewards, yielding "zero advantage results in no gradients for policy updates." Dynamic sampling filters out prompts with accuracy of 0 or 1, keeping batches filled with samples that generate effective gradients and maintain training signal consistency.

## (5) Reward Variance and Entropy Connection
The paper doesn't explicitly establish this connection. However, the analysis suggests that zero-gradient samples (from homogeneous rewards) reduce effective batch size, increasing gradient variance and dampening training signals—indirectly linking reward variance to exploration constraints.

content.content:
# Dr. GRPO: Normalization Bias Analysis

## (1) Std Normalization Bias Mechanism

The paper identifies a "question-level difficulty bias" caused by dividing the centered outcome reward by `std({R(q,o₁),...,R(q,oG)})`. This creates unequal weighting: questions with lower variance (too easy or too hard) receive disproportionately higher weights during policy updates, artificially amplifying their influence on learning.

## (2) When Std Approaches Zero

The paper doesn't explicitly address near-zero std scenarios, but the mechanism is clear: as std→0, the advantage term becomes undefined or explodes. Questions where all responses receive identical rewards (all correct or all incorrect) would produce undefined divisions, making the optimization numerically unstable and creating erratic gradient updates.

## (3) Difficulty Bias Mechanism

The authors explain: "Questions with lower standard deviations (e.g., those that are too easy or too hard, with the outcome rewards being almost all 1 or 0) are given higher weights during policy updates." This means trivial questions dominate training signals, potentially degrading performance on genuinely challenging problems.

## (4) How Removing Std Fixes It

By eliminating the std normalization term, Dr. GRPO recovers the unbiased Monte Carlo advantage: `Ã_i,t = R(q,o_i) - mean({R(q,o₁),...,R(q,oG)})`. This ensures equal question weighting regardless of difficulty, enabling more balanced policy learning.

## (5) Connection to Collapse Phenomena

The paper doesn't discuss mode collapse directly, but the length bias mechanism could indirectly cause entropy collapse—incorrect responses progressively lengthen due to the 1/|o_i| term favoring longer incorrect sequences, potentially reducing response diversity.

Based on the search results, here's what I found regarding LMRC, DocRE, evidence generation, and supporting sentences:

## Overview

LMRC (LLM with Relation Classifier) is a novel method aimed at bridging the performance gap between LLM-based DocRE methods and their conventional counterparts.

## LMRC Methodology

LMRC conceptualizes DocRE as a workflow comprising two stages: Relation Candidate Proposal (RCP) and Relation Classification (RC). In the RCP stage, a pre-processing classifier is applied, which explicitly harnesses attention mechanism to filter out NA entity pairs that do not harbour any relation. This strategic filtering drastically reduces the size of candidate space but also ensures that the subsequent stage operates on a more relevant set of entity pairs. Subsequently, the RC stage leverages the remarkable capabilities of LLMs to perform multi-classification within this refined candidate space.

## Document-Level Relation Extraction and Evidence

Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) aims to identify semantic relations among multiple entity pairs within a document. Evidence, defined as sentences containing clues for the relationship between an entity pair, has been shown to help DocRE systems focus on relevant texts, thus improving relation extraction.

More than 95% instances of DocRED require no more than 3 sentences as supporting evidence.

## Evidence Retrieval in DocRE

Evidence retrieval (ER) involves retrieving a minimal subset of sentences, termed "evidence sentences", essential for accurately predicting relations between entity pairs. Recent approaches like CDER use graph-based architectures to model collaborative patterns in evidence retrieval across multiple entity pairs in the same document.

title: \\\"GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization\\\"\\n    authors: NVIDIA Labs\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: ICML 2026\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: closest_prior_work\\n    key_finding: >\\n      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，\\n      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，\\n      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），\\n      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。\\n      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。\\n\\n  - {"success": true, "data": {"path": "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513_6/projects/faith-evidence-ie/literature_map.yaml", "content": "# Literature Map for faith-evidence-ie (FREIGE)
# Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE
# Updated: 2026-05-15

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（放大 importance sampling 上界）和 Dynamic Sampling
      来对抗 entropy collapse，在 AIME 2024 上超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse；CED reward 本身就能防止 mode collapse，

# Literature Map for faith-evidence-ie (FREIGE)
# Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE
# Updated: 2026-05-15 (W3 reviewer gap fill)

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
      关键洞察：GRPO 和 RAFT 的核心区别在于负样本处理——GRPO 混合正负样本训练，
      RAFT 只用正样本，但 RAFT 仍能达到相当性能，说明 rejection sampling 的简单性被低估了。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：(1) RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败，
      与该论文发现一致——rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting；
      (2) GRPO 主要优势来自过滤全错 prompt，这与我们 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 机制相同；
      (3) DocRE structured output 比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      强化了 offline RSFT 的合理性。

      规则约束方式与我们的 CED reward 在 motivation 上相似（都是引入外部知识约束），
      但 Ru-LLM 用 inference-time 规则验证（MCTS+CoT），我们用 training-time reward shaping（CED）。
      Ru-LLM 的规则是数据集级别的频繁模式，CED 是 instance-level 的 evidence faithfulness。

  - title: "GLiDRE: Generalist Lightweight model for Document-level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2508.00757
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.00757
    category: llm_docre
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      基于 dual-encoder 的轻量级零/少样本 DocRE 模型，
      预训练于 136K 文档的大规模 RE 数据。
      fully supervised Re-DocRED test F1=77.83，但这是 encoder-based 非 LLM generative。
      zero-shot Re-DocRED test F1=17.32（超越 LLaMA 3.3 70B 和 Mistral-Small 24B）。
    results:
      re_docred_dev_f1: 77.76
      re_docred_test_f1: 77.83
      re_docred_zero_shot_test_f1: 17.32
      fredo_in_domain_1doc_f1: 13.00
      fredo_in_domain_3doc_f1: 15.71
      backbone: dual-encoder (few hundred M params)
    evidence_generation: false
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      不同范式（encoder-based vs LLM generative）。GLiDRE 的 fully supervised F1=77.83
      远超 LLM-based 方法（RelPrior 54.80），但依赖大规模预训练数据和 encoder 架构。
      与我们不直接可比——我们关注 LLM generative 范式下的训练优化。

  - title: "AutoRE: Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.14888
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14888
    category: llm_docre
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RHF（Relation-Head-Facts）范式用 Mistral-7B + QLoRA 做端到端 DocRE。
      关键设计：先抽 relation，再抽 head entity，最后抽 fact triple。
      在多个 LLM 上达到 SOTA（当时）。
    results:
      re_docred_dev_f1_mistral: 53.01
      re_docred_test_f1_mistral: 51.91
      re_docred_dev_f1_vicuna: 54.29
      re_docred_test_f1_vicuna: 53.84
      docred_dev_f1_llama3: 45.76
      docred_test_f1_llama3: 45.96
      re_docred_dev_f1_llama3: 52.28
      re_docred_test_f1_llama3: 51.97
      backbone: Mistral-7B / Vicuna-7B / LLaMA3-8B (QLoRA)
    evidence_generation: false
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      QLoRA fine-tuning for DocRE 的先例。AutoRE_LLaMA3-8B 在 Re-DocRED test F1=51.97,
      DocRED test F1=45.96。我们的 SFT baseline 与之类似，
      RSFT 在此基础上引入 reward-guided sample selection 进一步提升。

# Literature Map for faith-evidence-ie (FREIGE)
# Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE
# Updated: 2026-05-15 (W3 reviewer gap fill)

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，
      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，
      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===

  - title: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"
    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.07708
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: closest_contrastive_precedent
    key_finding: >
      两步机制：(1) 离线采样 baseline response；(2) 用 baseline 计算 contrastive reward
      作为 PPO 的 penalty 项。效果：惩罚 reward uncertainty、根据任务难度自适应校准、
      减少 PPO 中的 variance。在 TL;DR 和 HH-RLHF 上持续优于标准 RLHF。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最接近的对比 reward 先例。关键差异：(1) 它是对 learned RM 输出的后处理对比，
      CED 是 reward function 本身就是对比判别（evidence vs. corrupted evidence）；
      (2) 它在 PPO 中验证，CED 在 GRPO 中验证；
      (3) 它是 domain-agnostic penalty，CED 是 task-specific faithfulness signal。
      stabilizing 机制相通但实现路径根本不同。

  - title: "Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EMNLP 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，
      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，
      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。

  - title: "Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。

  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===

  - title: "Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ACL 2025
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf
    category: evidence_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination
      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。

  - title: "Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EACL 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。

  - title: "Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024
    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，
      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。

  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===

  - title: "Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: OpenReview
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，
      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），
      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，
      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。

  - title: "On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.23585
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，
      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——
      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
      关键洞察：GRPO 和 RAFT 的核心区别在于负样本处理——GRPO 混合正负样本训练，
      RAFT 只用正样本，但 RAFT 仍能达到相当性能，说明 rejection sampling 的简单性被低估了。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：(1) RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败，
      与该论文发现一致——rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting；
      (2) GRPO 主要优势来自过滤全错 prompt，这与我们 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 机制相同；
      (3) DocRE structured output 比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      强化了 offline RSFT 的合理性。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2602.04391
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，
      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。
      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，
      融合方式需要重新设计。

  - title: "Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning
      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为
      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，
      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。
